import json
import unittest
from datetime import date

from tallybook.errors import ValidationError
from tallybook.export import (ExportError, money_to_dict, render_table, to_csv, to_json, transaction_to_dict,
                              transactions_from_json, transactions_to_csv, transactions_to_json)
from tallybook.model import Posting, Transaction
from tallybook.money import Money

CAFE = "Café, Bäcker"


def coffee():
    return Transaction(
        date(2024, 3, 1), CAFE, 'say "hi"',
        [Posting("Expenses:Food", Money(450, "USD"), "a, b"), Posting("Assets:Cash", Money(-450, "USD"))],
        ("lunch", "a", "a"), "!", 7)


class RenderTableTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_example(self):
        rows = [["Apple", 3, "1.50"], ["Kiwi", 12, "10.25"], ["Ünï", None, "x\ty"]]
        expected = ("Name   Qty  Price\n-----  ---  -----\nApple    3   1.50\nKiwi    12  10.25\n"
                    "Ünï           x y\n")
        self.assertEqual(render_table(["Name", "Qty", "Price"], rows, "lrr"), expected)

    def test_shapes(self):
        cases = [
            (["A", "B"], [], None, "A  B\n-  -\n"),
            ([], [["ignored"]], None, ""),
            (iter(["A", "B"]), (r for r in [(1, True)]), ["r", "l"], "A  B\n-  ----\n1  True\n"),
            (["A", "Bb"], [["x\r\ny", "z"]], ("l", "r"), "A    Bb\n---  --\nx  y  z\n"),
            (["Left", "R"], [["a", "b"]], None, "Left  R\n----  -\na     b\n"),
        ]
        for headers, rows, align, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(expected=expected):
                self.assertEqual(render_table(headers, rows, align), expected)

    def test_trailing_spaces_removed_and_wide_text_kept(self):
        out = render_table(["A", "B"], [["xxxxxxxx", ""]])
        self.assertEqual(out, "A         B\n--------  -\nxxxxxxxx\n")
        self.assertTrue(all(not line.endswith(" ") for line in out.splitlines()))

    def test_errors(self):
        bad = [(["A", "B"], [[1, 2]], "l"), (["A", "B"], [[1, 2]], "lrr"), (["A", "B"], [[1, 2]], "lx"),
               (["A", "B"], [[1, 2]], "LR"), (["A", "B"], [[1]], None), (["A"], [[1, 2]], "l"),
               (["A"], [[1]], 5)]
        for headers, rows, align in bad:
            with self.subTest(align=align, rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises(ExportError):
                    render_table(headers, rows, align)
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(ExportError, ValidationError))
        self.assertEqual(ExportError("x").code, "validation")


class CsvTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_to_csv_quoting(self):
        out = to_csv(["a", "b,c"], [[1, None], ['x"y', "l1\nl2"], [" t\t", "é"], ["cr\r", True]])
        self.assertEqual(out, 'a,"b,c"\n1,\n"x""y","l1\nl2"\n t\t,é\n"cr\r",True\n')
        self.assertEqual(to_csv(["h"], []), "h\n")

    def test_transactions_example(self):
        expected = ("id,date,flag,payee,narration,tags,account,amount,currency,note\n"
                    '7,2024-03-01,!,"Café, Bäcker","say ""hi""",a;lunch,Expenses:Food,4.50,USD,"a, b"\n'
                    '7,2024-03-01,!,"Café, Bäcker","say ""hi""",a;lunch,Assets:Cash,-4.50,USD,\n')
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_csv([coffee()]), expected)

    def test_edge_records(self):
        header = "id,date,flag,payee,narration,tags,account,amount,currency,note\n"
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_csv([]), header)
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_csv(iter([])), header)
        bare = Transaction(date(2024, 1, 2), "P")
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_csv([bare]), header + ",2024-01-02,*,P,,,,,,\n")
        mixed = Transaction(date(2024, 1, 2), "P", "", [Posting("Assets:Y", Money(-900, "JPY")),
                                                        Posting("Assets:B", None, "n")], (), "*", 3)
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_csv([mixed]),
                         header + "3,2024-01-02,*,P,,,Assets:Y,-900,JPY,\n3,2024-01-02,*,P,,,Assets:B,,,n\n")
        self.assertNotIn("\r", transactions_to_csv([coffee()]))


class JsonTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transaction_dict_and_text(self):
        d = transaction_to_dict(coffee())
        self.assertEqual(d["tags"], ["a", "lunch"])
        self.assertEqual(d["postings"][0], {"account": "Expenses:Food",
                                            "amount": {"amount": "4.50", "currency": "USD"}, "note": "a, b"})
        self.assertEqual(d["id"], 7)
        text = transactions_to_json([coffee()])
        self.assertEqual(text, json.dumps([d], indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        self.assertIn("Café, Bäcker", text)
        self.assertEqual(transactions_to_json([]), "[]\n")
        none = transaction_to_dict(Transaction(date(2024, 1, 2), "P", "", [Posting("A", None)]))
        self.assertIsNone(none["id"])
        self.assertIsNone(none["postings"][0]["amount"])

    def test_helpers(self):
        self.assertEqual(money_to_dict(Money(-5, "USD")), {"amount": "-0.05", "currency": "USD"})
        self.assertIsNone(money_to_dict(None))
        self.assertEqual(to_json({"b": 1, "a": ["é"]}), '{\n  "a": [\n    "é"\n  ],\n  "b": 1\n}\n')

    def test_round_trip(self):
        txs = [Transaction(date(2024, 3, 1), "A", "n", [Posting("Assets:Cash", Money(-1250, "JPY"), "x"),
                                                        Posting("Expenses:Food", None)], ("a", "b"), "!", 4),
               Transaction(date(2024, 3, 2), "B")]
        self.assertEqual(transactions_from_json(transactions_to_json(txs)), txs)
        self.assertEqual(transactions_from_json("[]"), [])


class FromJsonErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_defaults(self):
        [tx] = transactions_from_json('[{"date": "2024-03-01", "payee": "P", "postings": [{"account": "A"}],'
                                      ' "tags": ["b", "a", "b"], "id": null}]')
        self.assertEqual((tx.id, tx.flag, tx.narration, tx.tags), (None, "*", "", ("a", "b")))
        self.assertEqual(tx.postings, [Posting("A", None, "")])

    def test_errors_are_positioned(self):
        good = '{"date": "2024-03-01", "payee": "P", "postings": []}'

        def tx(**kw):
            base = {"date": "2024-03-01", "payee": "P", "postings": []}
            base.update(kw)
            return json.dumps([json.loads(good), base])

        money = {"amount": "1.00", "currency": "USD"}
        cases = [
            ("not json", ""), ("{}", ""), ('"x"', ""), ("[1]", "transaction 1"),
            ('[{"date": "2024-03-01", "payee": "P"}]', "transaction 1"),
            ('[{"date": "2024-03-01", "postings": []}]', "transaction 1"),
            ('[{"payee": "P", "postings": []}]', "transaction 1"),
            (tx(colour="x"), "transaction 2"), (tx(date="2024-02-30"), "transaction 2"),
            (tx(date=20240301), "transaction 2"), (tx(id=0), "transaction 2"), (tx(id=True), "transaction 2"),
            (tx(id=1.5), "transaction 2"), (tx(id="1"), "transaction 2"), (tx(flag="x"), "transaction 2"),
            (tx(flag=None), "transaction 2"), (tx(payee=3), "transaction 2"), (tx(narration=None), "transaction 2"),
            (tx(tags="a"), "transaction 2"), (tx(tags=[1]), "transaction 2"), (tx(postings={}), "transaction 2"),
            (tx(postings=[1]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A"}, {}]), "transaction 2 posting 2"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": 1}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "note": 1}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "extra": 1}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": "1.00 USD"}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": {"amount": "1.00"}}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": dict(money, extra=1)}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": {"amount": 1, "currency": "USD"}}]), "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": {"amount": "4.505", "currency": "USD"}}]),
             "transaction 2 posting 1"),
            (tx(postings=[{"account": "A", "amount": {"amount": "4.50", "currency": "ZZZ"}}]),
             "transaction 2 posting 1"),
        ]
        for text, prefix in cases:
            with self.subTest(text=text[:70]):
                with self.assertRaises(ExportError) as cm:
                    transactions_from_json(text)
                if prefix:
                    self.assertTrue(cm.exception.message.startswith(prefix), cm.exception.message)
                else:
                    self.assertFalse(cm.exception.message.startswith("transaction"), cm.exception.message)

    def test_non_text_input(self):
        for value in (None, 5, b"[]"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ExportError):
                    transactions_from_json(value)

    def test_huge_number_is_error_not_crash(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ExportError):
            transactions_from_json('[{"id": %s}]' % ("9" * 5000))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
